description: This file manages local storage operations for service requests, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving requests, with seed data and normalization functions.

methods.name: loadRequestsFromStorage
methods.description: Loads requests from localStorage; seeds initial data if empty or corrupt.

methods.name: createRequestLocal
methods.description: Creates a new request in localStorage and returns the created record.

methods.name: updateRequestLocal
methods.description: Updates an existing request by id in localStorage and returns the updated record.

methods.name: deleteRequestLocal
methods.description: Deletes a request by id from localStorage.

methods.name: getRequestLocal
methods.description: Retrieves a request by id from localStorage.
